title: Dynamic covalent interaction induced formation of a bortezomib–andrographolide complex and construction of the dual-drug delivery system
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,28805-28814
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04640H, Paper
Open Access

Shihui Qiao, Hui Long, Yun Song, Xu Dong, Huamin Zhong, Huanfeng Meng, Jingwen Gong, Yong Wang, Yiheng Liu, Haiying Zhang, Lujia Mao
The BTZ-AND complex exhibits broad-spectrum anti-tumour effects on U251 glioma cells and A549 cells. The BTZ-AND@BSA nanoparticles were prepared and demonstrated notable potential in cellular uptake and pH-responsive drug release behavior.
